items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:150:1
items.html: The Mochin of the anterior to ZON, and then the name HaVaYaH comes to the Keter of ZA of the anterior, in the discernment of four letters alone, etc. For at the time of the Mochin of face to face too, the separated Nukva takes all the discernments that are in the Nukva of the Guf of ZA. And it is found that she now takes all the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of ZA from the discernment of the anterior, which are: the Gematria 26 of the simple HaVaYaH, which is Keter; and the Gematria MA [45] of the HaVaYaH with the filling of MA, which is Hochma; and the Gematria of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling, which is Bina; and the Gematria of the HaVaYaH with the filling of MA, which is ZA. And these nine Sefirot of the Nukva within his Guf, from the discernment of the anterior, the separated Nukva takes for herself, to the discernments that correspond to them in the nine Sefirot of the HaVaYaH of BON, which is her own discernment.
